title: The build is timed on full genomes and the large protein sets under several masks
body:
The sweep script at `tmp-claude/2026-11-05-sweep/sweep.sh` builds an input under every flag set and mask with the dev build and the new one, times both and compares the bytes. It has run on `uniprot.fa`, chm13 chr21 and `uniprot_sprot.fa`. The real-sized inputs are on catalyst.

| input | size | suffix width | .sufr with LCP | without |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| hg38.fa, hs1.fa | 3.1 Gbase | 32-bit | 28 GB | 15 GB |
| /data/mgnify/fa/mgy_proteins_1.fa | 21.5 GB, 100 M records | 64-bit | 366 GB | 194 GB |
| /data/AllTheBacteria/sampling_2024, 20,903 genomes concatenated | 84 GB | 64-bit | 1.4 TB | 760 GB |

On 2026-11-05 catalyst had 1.4 TB free on /home at 90% and 4.4 TB free on the root partition. Jack is running a backup and cleanup pass on /home first.

## Proposal

- Masks: none, 12 of 17 (`11011011011011011`), PatternHunter 11 of 18, and a 20 of 29 for DNA. DNA with `--dna` and `--dna -a`.
- Every output under a scratch directory on the root partition, deleted after its comparison.
- For mgnify and AllTheBacteria: no LCP, and one output at a time, compared by sha256 rather than `cmp`, since old and new cannot both be held.
- AllTheBacteria in steps of 1,000 and 5,000 genomes before the full set, so the old build's time at 84 GB is known before it is paid.
- The old build on the unmasked and 12-of-17 cells; sais64 through the harness's `measure` binary for its time only, since it sorts the raw text without sufr's delimiters.

## Open

- The mgnify file's 100 million record names are held in memory and written into the header; nothing has exercised that.
- Where the scratch directory goes once the cleanup is done.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/fdde2c6d
notes.text: uniprot_sprot.fa (288 MB, all of Swiss-Prot) on catalyst at 16 threads, dev build beside cabe70c, one run per cell: no mask 7.6 and 2.9 s; 101 4.8 and 3.7; 1101 5.9 and 3.9; 10111011 7.5 and 4.3; PatternHunter 8.4 and 5.0; 12 of 17 8.3 and 5.0; weight 11 8.1 and 5.0; weight 12 8.0 and 5.2. All 27 buildable cells match the dev build byte for byte across the plain, -n 1 and --memory-budget 4 flag sets; the 12 cells with masks past the 12-position cap are refused. Before cabe70c the masked cells took 5.2 to 6.5 s. What is left above the unmasked time is the masked scan.
